$comment: Square WRAPS its responses: the object lives under `payment`, where Stripe returns it at the top level. Reproduced rather than flattened, because an author who wires {{ $json.data.payment.id }} against a fake must find the same path when a real payment arrives. Read from Square's own OpenAPI document (CreatePaymentResponse -> payment, errors), not from memory.

values.$comment: Drawn once. Square echoes the amount and currency inside amount_money and again inside total_money, and two independent draws would produce a payment whose totals disagree with themselves -- a shape Square never sends.

payment.$statusComment: COMPLETED rather than APPROVED. A faked payment that stopped at APPROVED would make the downstream branch -- act only when the money actually moved -- untestable, which is the branch most worth covering.
